in_sanskrit.name: असिर्वस
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Asirvas is derived from the Sanskrit words 'asu' meaning 'not' and 'rvas' meaning 'sorrow'. The name signifies someone who is not sorrowful or free from sorrow.

in_hindi.name: असिर्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Asirvas in Hindi is pronounced as 'asirvās'. The meaning of the name is 'free from sorrow' or 'without sorrow'.

in_tamil.name: அசிர்வஸ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Asirvas in Tamil is pronounced as 'acirvas'. The meaning of the name is 'one who removes sorrow from others' or 'someone who consoles others'.

in_telugu.name: అశీవ౱స్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Asirvas in Telugu is pronounced as 'ashīvvaś'. The meaning of the name is 'without sorrow' or 'free from sorrow'.
